title: Hearty Snappy American Beef Burger
description: A peppery and snappy weeknight American dish featuring horseradish and pickle, perfect for a sugar-free friendly meal.

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 or 70/30 lean to fat ratio works well

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, around 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties, about 3/4 inch thick, and season with black pepper.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
Let the patties rest for a few minutes before assembling the burgers.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a slice of cheese, a few slices of pickle, a spoonful of horseradish sauce, some shredded lettuce, and a slice of tomato.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining burgers.
Serve and enjoy your snappy American beef burgers.
